parameters.description: Search authoritative internship documents using real vector similarity. Requires exact role_id and catalog_version from the request plus a concise input query. Returns ok:false when no indexed source exists. Never substitute another role.

parameters.description: Calculate exact calendar days from today in Asia/Kolkata until an internship deadline. Call with input containing one real ISO date, for example 2026-12-15. Negative days mean expired. Does not infer closing hours or modify data.

Count words in the EXACT final plain-text cover letter, including greeting and signature, and return its SHA-256 digest. Call with the complete letter in input, not a summary or a previous draft. Uses whitespace_v1 and a 250-word limit. Recount after any edits. Does not save or approve the letter.
parameters.inputSchema: {"type":"object","properties":{"input":{"type":"string","description":"The exact plain-text letter with actual line breaks.","maxLength":20000}},"required":["input"],"additionalProperties":false}

parameters.content:
## Publish after connecting the helper
1. Choose Final Role Search in search_internship_roles. Preserve the three input expressions.
2. Select Header Auth: X-Internship-MCP-Key with a strong random secret.
3. Publish and copy the actual Production MCP URL.
4. Paste it into Workflow Settings in Final Orchestrator and Verification Settings in Final Verification. Use the same MCP credential on all their MCP Client nodes.
